metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds eleven lines, the first sixpence, and Titus in the fourth act.

yesterday: The eleven lines are on her sheet, and they are night.
Sixpence is paid. It is the first Monday of the winter reckoning. The copper had it.
Titus was at two. You were done in the fourth. Thomas kept his own cue. The Rose bill was Seven Days and Wise Man.
The jaw did the consonants once. Tomorrow at nine the farewell is the Queen's, and the king is the afternoon, the second time.
